title: chestcraft
description: Craft straight out of nearby chests at any crafting table — the recipe book even shows what your storage can make.
body:
# ChestCraft

  **Craft straight out of your storage.** ChestCraft upgrades *every* crafting table so it can pull ingredients from chests, barrels, and other containers sitting nearby — no more shuffling stacks back and forth just to craft.

  ## How it works

  Put a chest (or several) next to any crafting table, open the table, and click a recipe in the **recipe book**. ChestCraft takes the ingredients from your inventory first, then from any container within range — so you can craft even with an empty inventory, as long as the materials are in storage close by.

  The recipe book even **highlights what you can craft from nearby storage**, not just from what's in your pockets.

  ## Features

  - 🧰 **Craft from nearby containers** — any crafting table sources ingredients from chests, barrels, shulker boxes and more within a configurable radius (default: 6 blocks).
  - 🔎 **Storage-aware recipe book** — recipes you can make from nearby storage light up as craftable.
  - 🧩 **Works with modded storage** — uses the standard item-handler capability, so most modded inventories work out of the box.
  - ⚙️  **Configurable range** — set the search radius anywhere from 1 to 32 blocks.
  - 🪶  **No new blocks or GUIs** — it's just your normal crafting table, upgraded. Sneak-right-click still places blocks as usual.

  ## Configuration

  `config/chestcraft-server.toml`:

  - **`radius`** — how far (in blocks) to search around the table for containers. Default `6`, range `1`–`32`.

  ## Multiplayer

  ChestCraft must be installed on **both the server and every client**.

  ## Requirements

  - Minecraft **1.21.1**
  - **NeoForge** 21.1.0 or newer
